messages.content: You write structured JSON passages for an existing Pharmacy First local template for a pharmacy business. Do not write new HTML. Write a professional, locally informed Pharmacy First page for readers in Wombwell. Follow the supplied section roles and tone. Preserve the supplied approved clinical content. Write connected local passages, not isolated sentences or a list of places. Use verified local history, community or industry context to create recognition and substantive local identity. Do not force every supplied fact into the page. Lead with the service and reader’s needs. Weave local context into the introduction and ‘Why Wombwell patients start with the pharmacist’. Make the transition to the service natural without inventing patient habits, health demand, GP waiting times or referral relationships. Keep the pharmacy’s actual location clear. Do not invent travel, parking, opening-hours, availability or treatment promises. Do not claim the author lives locally. Do not narrate evidence records, fact IDs, sources, publishers or provenance. Do not rewrite locked clinical facts, the seven conditions, pathway eligibility, consultation process, or safety wording. Do not copy another town's facts. Do not restate renderer-owned consultation process, eligibility, escalation, safety-netting or FAQ copy. Return only valid JSON matching the schema. No markdown. No HTML.

parsedCopy.heroIntroduction: Pharmacy First is available to people in Wombwell, offering NHS consultations for eligible common conditions. This service is provided by Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield, supporting residents of Wombwell and the wider Barnsley area.
parsedCopy.localIntroduction: Wombwell is in the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire. The area features a public library, which hosts local history sessions run by Wombwell Heritage Group. Citizens Advice also holds advice and welfare rights drop-in sessions at the library. Wombwell station, part of the National Rail network, displays community artwork including the Wombwell unicorn emblem and references to local landmarks such as Roly Poly Hill and the Wishing Tree at Wombwell Park.
localContextParagraphs: Wombwell’s public library and station artwork highlight the area’s active community spaces and local heritage. With NHS general practice services provided from Wombwell Medical Centre, residents have established routes to healthcare support. For NHS Pharmacy First consultations, people in Wombwell can access Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield, which is approximately 1.7 km away in a straight line. Pharmacy First can help with eligible common conditions, and the pharmacist will confirm what can be assessed on the day according to NHS pathway criteria.
parsedCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Pharmacy First consultations for Wombwell residents are provided at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield.
parsedCopy.localCtaBridge: Contact the pharmacy team to discuss your symptoms or book a consultation.

This service is provided by Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield, supporting residents of Wombwell and the wider Barnsley area.
Wombwell is in the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire.
The area features a public library, which hosts local history sessions run by Wombwell Heritage Group.
Citizens Advice also holds advice and welfare rights drop-in sessions at the library.

Wombwell station, part of the National Rail network, displays community artwork including the Wombwell unicorn emblem and references to local landmarks such as Roly Poly Hill and the Wishing Tree at Wombwell Park.
Wombwell’s public library and station artwork highlight the area’s active community spaces and local heritage.
With NHS general practice services provided from Wombwell Medical Centre, residents have established routes to healthcare support.
For NHS Pharmacy First consultations, people in Wombwell can access Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield, which is approximately 1.7 km away in a straight line.
